issues.title: The 8-epsilon pressure floor does not universally imply the requested residual tolerance
issues.notes: Returned residual can exceed the requested tolerance by about 1.033x at the floor.

issues.title: FunctionalConvergenceError lacks the complete public execution-error metadata contract
issues.notes: application_family, stage, and step are absent; SimulationExecutionError.to_metadata raises AttributeError.

issues.title: Non-SimulationExecutionError interruptions can leave workflow metadata running
issues.notes: CPCE details also require JSON-finite values.

issues.title: Explicit Channel production-checkpoint upgrade from a read-only source leaves read-only staging residue
issues.notes: Present since rc5; limited to the explicit production upgrade path.

issues.title: ChannelPressureConvergenceError is not pickleable
issues.notes: Present since rc5.

issues.title: Cross-filesystem symlink as the immediate checkpoint parent is rejected by the NFS-compatible publisher
issues.notes: target.parent.lstat().st_dev observes the symlink rather than the destination; use stat() or resolve the parent. HPCC reproduced for Periodic and Channel functional export_checkpoint; production output directories are unaffected.

issues.title: Directory-fsync publication failures are not classified separately
issues.first_found: v0.2.1 independent acceptance, with pre-existing v0.2.0 behavior
issues.notes: A post-rename parent-directory fsync error reports failure after publication. Real HPCC NFS directory fsync returned zero.

issues.title: A lost mkdir-placeholder reply can leave a mode-000 empty final directory
issues.notes: The operation fails closed but the empty placeholder requires manual removal.

issues.title: Placeholder ownership and duplicate cleanup can race with inode reuse
issues.notes: Ownership uses only (st_dev, st_ino), and the rename-failure path can attempt placeholder removal twice.

issues.title: Functional Periodic reader exposes PermissionError for a mode-000 placeholder
issues.first_found: v0.2.1 independent acceptance, confirmed pre-existing in v0.2.0
issues.notes: The fail-closed reader exception is not mapped to the public checkpoint-error family.

issues.title: Use of the NFS-compatible checkpoint publication path is not observable in metadata or diagnostics
issues.notes: Observability only; the fallback marker must not become checkpoint identity.

issues.title: Checkpoint formats without digests cannot detect coordinated progress tampering
issues.notes: Includes Plane format-2 checkpoint.json; this is not a regression.

issues.title: Some restart rejections still expose plain ValueError
issues.notes: Includes Plane compatibility-identity tampering and Periodic save_start beyond the final step.

issues.title: Invalid parameter values and snapshot dtype, NaN, or missing data can expose native runtime exceptions
issues.notes: Failures occur before tensor computation and produce no output.

issues.title: Metadata persists device normalization but not all compilation normalization
issues.notes: Other normalized values and compilation_identity are not persisted.

issues.title: Float32 fixed-work pressure solves can fail closed after excessive unnecessary iterations
issues.first_found: rc5/rc6 acceptance, behavior present since rc4
issues.notes: Observed when fixed work substantially exceeds the iterations required for convergence.

issues.title: The wheel still includes legacy pssolver.control and experimental qualification modules
issues.notes: Packaging cleanup only; do not confuse the legacy module with PSSolver-Control.

issues.title: Robin residual behavior is not documented as an independent gate
issues.first_found: rc1 audit, reconfirmed by rc5/rc6 acceptance
issues.notes: Documentation debt; Robin is not currently publicly executable.

issues.title: Plane metadata retains the Plane_beris_edwards_stokes.py script label
issues.notes: Cosmetic metadata debt.

issues.title: Checkpoint generation labels are supplied by the caller rather than self-proven by the checkpoint
issues.notes: Accepted design limitation; retained for visibility.

issues.title: Verify that the TF32 policy scope covers backward execution
issues.notes: Functional device=auto was resolved; backward TF32 scope has not been independently verified.

issues.title: Lifting wall physics and runtime dtype coercion remain deferred
issues.first_found: rc1 audit and rc5 supplemental acceptance
issues.notes: Includes non-convergent DST wall projection and complex-to-real truncation before validation.

issues.title: Architectural redundancy backlog
issues.notes: Nine architecture-cleanup items are intentionally grouped and remain outside the v0.2 maintenance line.

issues.title: No released fixture covers the rc1/rc2 Channel functional odd-periodic-axis branch
issues.notes: The branch remains NOT_RUN because no historical fixture exists.

issues.title: CUDA Hermitian consistency lacks a t>=200 long-horizon qualification
issues.notes: The long-horizon audit has been performed on CPU but not CUDA.

issues.title: No authentic historical lifted checkpoint fixture exists
issues.notes: Lifting is not publicly executable, but historical rejection semantics cannot be fully validated without a real fixture.
